profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit educational organization whose website offers learning resources across a range of subjects. The site's harvested text returned only a client challenge response at the time of collection, limiting the detail available from the company's own pages.

Khan Academy's tracked AI product is Khanmigo, an educational AI tutor categorized under Education and Research AI. The held facts note that Khanmigo involves student interaction data, is subject to COPPA compliance considerations, and raises questions around pedagogical bias.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are associated with Khan Academy in the held facts.
